summary: Frontend-only iteration 13 review of AgriERP UI/UX overhaul + rebrand + validation gates. Tested login, 3-step signup wizard, collapsible sidebar, topbar user menu + logout, mobile drawer at 390x844 across 5 screens, CrudPage inline validation (Sales, Parties), Party Ledger autocomplete presence, redesigned super-admin console layout, and RBAC regression with acc1@demo.com. Passed 41 assertions; 1 real minor issue (mobile Dashboard horizontal overflow) and 2 false-positives from test script.

ui_bugs.issue: Body horizontal scroll appears: document.scrollWidth=738 on 390px viewport. Root cause: DataTable in /app/frontend/src/components/Shell.jsx line 46-47 uses <div className='overflow-x-auto ...'><table className='w-full min-w-[720px]'>. Wrapper has overflow-x-auto but no explicit max-w constraint, so the table's 720px min-width bleeds up the layout on mobile. Sales/Ledger/Users/Roles pages (which have fewer/no rows) did not repro; Dashboard reproes reliably because Category Summary always renders 720px table on load. Fix suggestion: add 'max-w-full' (or 'w-full') to the wrapper div in Shell.jsx DataTable and to <div className='overflow-x-auto border ...'> in DashboardInsights.jsx line 86.

action_items: Fix mobile horizontal overflow on Dashboard: add 'max-w-full' to overflow-x-auto wrapper in /app/frontend/src/components/Shell.jsx DataTable and /app/frontend/src/components/DashboardInsights.jsx so 720px min-w tables scroll internally instead of pushing the page.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminLayout.jsx: mobile drawer duplicates the entire sidebar JSX (React actually renders two DOM copies since 'sidebar' is a JSX expression used in both aside and mobile drawer). This is fine functionally but means every data-testid inside the sidebar (sidebar-close, sidebar-logo, company-select, nav-* items, logout-btn) exists TWICE in the DOM at all times, and the desktop copy is hidden via 'hidden lg:block'. Automation and screen readers can be confused. Consider rendering the sidebar only in the active layout branch, or add unique testids like sidebar-close-mobile.

AdminLayout.jsx line 128-131: useEffect auto-expands the group containing the current route but never collapses previously open groups when the user navigates away — minor, groups just accumulate open state (acceptable UX).

Signup.jsx: user-typed GSTIN is uppercased on submit but not on step-2 validation, so a lower-case GSTIN like '24abcde1234f1z5' would show a format error even though checkRule() already does .toUpperCase() internally — actually validate.js line 26 already uppercases for gstin/ifsc, so this is fine.
Shell.jsx DataTable wrapper missing max-w-full/w-full — causes the mobile overflow bug reported above.

rca of the issue: Mobile Dashboard overflow RCA: <div class='overflow-x-auto rounded-sm border border-border bg-white'><table class='w-full min-w-[720px]'> — the overflow-x-auto wrapper has no explicit width constraint. On mobile, block auto-width should normally fill 100% of parent, but combined with the min-w-[720px] table child and the flex-1 main column, the intrinsic min content width propagates up and pushes the outer container beyond 390px. Add 'max-w-full' (or explicit 'w-full min-w-0') on the wrapper to force it to respect parent width and let the table scroll internally. Repro steps: (1) login as merge_test_1788760554@demo.com, (2) set viewport 390x844, (3) navigate to /admin/dashboard, (4) evaluate document.documentElement.scrollWidth → 738 (should be ≤390).
